set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- Every export is classified primary, alias, experimental, or utility.
- Every parameter is operational, explicitly ignored, or explicitly unsupported.
- Value, residual, error, iterations, status, and convergence have common definitions.
- Unregularized GW terminology does not imply a global optimum.
- Implementation/test discrepancies are fixed or linked to tickets.
set.title: Specify the supported solver contract and compatibility policy
